purpose: Offline development coordination and resource planning for builder agents. This plan does not launch agents or execute product-runtime work.

scope.goal: Future goal: serve two million U.S. households, including immigrants. The initial segment, participant incentive, payer/revenue model, accessibility/localization, representative workload and unit economics require validation before scale.
scope.professional_rigor: Wall Street-level rigor is a validation target; this catalog and prototype do not establish institutional readiness or approval.
scope.excluded_from_this_increment: Full implementation of all 338 master requirements, new property strategies, live provider deployments, actual transactions, trained predictive models, and autonomous product agents.

resource_notes.integrator: One dedicated coordinator/integrator is reserved separately from three worker slots.
resource_notes.cuda_device: No CUDA device is available in this build environment; code review is not a hardware execution result.
resource_notes.r_runtime: No R runtime is available in this build environment; an exchange contract is not an executed R validation.
resource_notes.cpu: CPU work is permitted, but physical CPU count, hardware model and production capacity are not asserted.

scheduling_policy.priority_order: Lower priority number first, then remaining critical-path estimate, then stable ticket ID.
scheduling_policy.estimate_basis: All estimated_minutes values are planning assumptions. Relative start/finish times are simulated build effort; they are not calendar bookings, measured speed or delivery commitments.
scheduling_policy.dependency_rule: Only completed prerequisites satisfy dependencies. Planned descendants of blocked/deferred/resource-unavailable prerequisites remain blocked.
scheduling_policy.ownership_rule: Each active ticket consumes exactly one agent_worker or one integrator. Overlapping file or ancestor-directory write scopes serialize.
scheduling_policy.completion_rule: Move a ticket to completed only after its acceptance evidence has been reviewed. Keep completed/skipped/unavailable distinctions and rework history.
scheduling_policy.in_progress_rule: In-progress tickets occupy their resources from relative minute zero; estimated_minutes is the assumed remaining effort.
scheduling_policy.ai_rule: Product AI and autonomous runtime-agent phases are disabled and deferred. A build-time scheduler does not create or host either.
scheduling_policy.scope_rule: Ready work can be accelerated only within resource, file ownership, review and dependency constraints.
scheduling_policy.owner_rule: One active ticket per named builder owner/lane; reassign roles explicitly between planning runs rather than scheduling the same builder twice.

roadmap.exit_gate: Scheduler rejects invalid plans and reports blocked resources without launching agents.

roadmap.purpose: Build and verify evidence records, financial semantics and conditional probability calculations.
roadmap.exit_gate: Meaningful positive and negative cases reconcile with independent references; CUDA limitations are explicit.

roadmap.purpose: Join reviewed document inputs to underwriting through explicit bindings and stale-input holds.

roadmap.purpose: Verify default non-AI behavior, source integrity, exact arithmetic, typed R exchange and actual execution status.

roadmap.purpose: Add an operator review interface, accessibility, localization and source-to-number navigation.

roadmap.purpose: Add authorized live sources, complete historical outcomes and measured operating economics.

roadmap.purpose: Later add NVIDIA parsing/OCR, embedding/reranking and evidence-grounded assistance.
